cover_letter:
Dear Summit Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Stage Marketing & Social Media position at Summit. With a background rooted in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to apply my skills to support your mission of elevating Belgian and Flemish audio productions. My profile as a digital marketer who builds and optimizes websites, writes ranking content, and leverages AI tools positions me to contribute effectively to your dynamic team.

My experience directly aligns with the social media and content creation aspects of this internship. At Episto and in my freelance work, I have consistently managed website content, crafted SEO-optimized blog posts, and utilized tools like Canva for visual content. I also have direct experience with social media integration during my time as a Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts. My fluent English and proficiency in Dutch, as outlined in my CV, enable me to craft clear, adaptable messaging for diverse audiences, crucial for promoting audio projects and engaging with listeners.

Furthermore, my capabilities in market research and data analysis would be valuable for informing your marketing strategies. I regularly conduct keyword research, perform technical SEO audits, and analyze performance using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. This foundation in data-driven insights will allow me to assist in understanding audience behavior and trends, contributing to the development of effective marketing campaigns for new and existing shows. My remote experience as a Junior Digital Marketer also prepares me for a hybrid work environment.

I am adept at managing multiple tasks and have a keen eye for detail, as demonstrated by building complex websites and maintaining extensive client catalogues. My experience supporting client websites and managing member profiles for organizations like majistraleczacilari.org.tr also speaks to foundational skills in online interaction and community engagement. While my academic background is in Applied Computer Science, it provides a robust technical understanding that complements my practical marketing skills.

I am genuinely enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my blend of digital marketing expertise and technical acumen to Summit. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your team in strengthening the presence of local audio content.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
Extensive experience in digital marketing, including SEO, content writing, website management, and social media integration.
Proficiency in content creation tools like Canva and publishing platforms like WordPress for diverse client projects.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in keyword research, SEO audits, and performance tracking using Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch, with a proven ability to manage multiple tasks in a hybrid work environment.
Foundational experience in e-commerce (Shopify) and online community support, useful for partner relations and listener engagement.
